title: Counting One to Ten
label: ch:ka-numbers-one-to-ten
canDo: I can count from one to ten in Kannada, one word at a time, and read each number word off the page in Kannada letters.

payoff.summary: Count ondu through hattu aloud, reading each word in Kannada script, and hear the p to h shift that turns Tamil pattu into Kannada hattu.
